_comments: Shared pipeline view bound by the Sales dashboard Inspect strip and the All Deals rail.
GridState carries column order, currency, and status colour so those surfaces cannot drift.
IsShared so every user can load it. UserID is the install Owner — same UUID forms uses.
Default sort (#371 item 19): ClosedAt, then ExpectedCloseDate, both ascending. ClosedAt is empty on
every open deal, so open deals come first and closed ones follow in the order they closed. GridState
sorts on field + direction only and has no nulls-last option, so open deals with no Expected Close
still lead the open block. Null order is the database's: SQL Server puts NULL first in an ascending
sort. PostgreSQL puts it last, which would put closed deals first; revisit when the PostgreSQL
Probability is stored 0-100; the 'percent' format divides by 100 and shows e.g. 40%.
ClosedAt is a hidden column because it is the first sort key: the grid can show a sort only on
one of its columns, and a sort it cannot show is read back as a user's sort, which resets the
